body:
Adds a small "Examples and projects using Sepo" section to the README: a 7-row table pointing to live deployments — the three templates (Lean Workspace, literature, digital garden, each with its site) and projects running on Sepo (the Brownian motion / Sphere packing / PrimeNumberTheoremAnd blueprint companions, and the Augmented Mind site maintained through Sepo issues).

All repo links are public and every site URL is the repo's live homepage (verified). Placement: directly after the intro list, before the fold.
